replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: The cell death bar chart in panel A reports mean±s.d. from three independent experiments, providing both the n-number (3) and the replicate type (independent experiments). The accompanying western blots are representative, unquantified images and do not require replicate reporting.

Panel B shows a quantified cell-death bar chart with error bars, but neither the panel nor the legend states how many replicates were performed or what type of replicate (e.g. independent experiments) they represent.

replicate_statements: Mean±s.d. of three experiments is reported.
outputs.explanation: Panel C's cell death time-course data are reported as mean±s.d. of three experiments, giving both an n-number (3) and a replicate designation (experiments), which is sufficient for the bar/line summary statistics shown.

Panel D presents a quantified cell-death bar chart with error bars, but the legend only describes the experimental setup and timing (40 h after transfection) without stating the number or type of replicates underlying the mean/error bar values.
